journey.name: receive onchain only without channel
journey.description:
Verifies that a funded wallet with no Lightning channel can only receive on-chain: the Receive sheet offers the Savings tab and nothing that buys Lightning liquidity, and Home shows neither the Spend suggestion card nor the channels-closing banner. Blocktank channel purchases were removed in synonymdev/bitkit-android#1669: there is no "Receive Lightning funds" (CJIT) button or onboarding, and the Transfer To Spending and Transfer from Savings buttons open the "No automatic transfer" sheet, and the Spending and Auto tabs appear only when the wallet can create a Lightning invoice over a ready channel with inbound liquidity.
Precondition: a freshly onboarded dev wallet on the staging regtest backend with NO Lightning channel (open, pending or closed), USDT disabled and no hardware wallet paired, funded with an on-chain deposit: ./lsp POST /regtest/chain/deposit with the Savings address from Receive, Show Details, then ./lsp POST /regtest/chain/mine '{"count":3}', and wait about 20 seconds for the balance and the activity row to appear. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Verify the Savings balance card (testTag "ActivitySavings") shows the deposit and the Spending balance card (testTag "ActivitySpending") shows 0
Verify the home screen has no Spend suggestion card (testTag "Suggestion-lightning") and no channels-closing banner (testTag "ChannelsClosingBanner"), scrolling the suggestions row if needed
Verify the Savings tab (testTag "Tab-savings") is selected and the QR code (testTag "QRCode") is visible
Verify there is no Spending tab (testTag "Tab-spending") and no Auto tab (testTag "Tab-auto")
Verify there is no "Receive Lightning funds" button anywhere on the sheet

Tap "Edit" (testTag "SpecifyInvoiceButton"), tap the amount field (testTag "ReceiveNumberPadTextField"), enter a small amount (for example "N1" then "N0" twice), tap Continue (testTag "ReceiveNumberPadSubmit") and then "QR Code" (testTag "ShowQrReceive")
Verify the sheet returns to the QR screen with no liquidity or channel confirm screen in between, the Savings tab is still selected and there is still no Spending tab (testTag "Tab-spending")
Close the sheet, open the Savings wallet (testTag "ActivitySavings") and tap the "Transfer To Spending" button (testTag "TransferToSpending")

Verify the sheet (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableSheet") shows the title "No automatic transfer" and the text "Unfortunately, the service to automatically transfer funds to your spending balance is no longer available. You can still manually open a Lightning channel to top up your spending balance.", and no close date line (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableCloseDate"); tap "Cancel" (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableButton") and verify the Savings wallet screen is still shown
Go back, open the Spending wallet (testTag "ActivitySpending"), verify no notice (testTag "ChannelsClosingNotice") is shown and tap the "Transfer from Savings" button (testTag "TransferFromSavings")

Verify the same sheet (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableSheet") opens with no close date line (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableCloseDate"), tap "Cancel" (testTag "ChannelsUnavailableButton") and verify the Spending wallet screen is still shown
